If lambda!=ln2, M_A/I_A->4,J_A/I_A->0,L_A/I_A->4. If lambda=ln2, M_A/I_A->3,J_A/I_A->1,L_A/I_A->4. Thus universal M_A<=K I_A or L_A<=K I_A requires K>=4. The y-first tree has Lambda_T/I(F)=w/2+O(1), also with the same symmetric leaf certificate. At the identical trees, B_T+9 E Ileaf<=14 I(F), because H(G)<=5 I(G) and H(F)<=5 I(F). These refute only a universal scalar Lambda payment for the specified schedules/leaf class, not arbitrary adaptive y orders, LOG_ALLOCATION local bound, C019 or FEI. Finally, for fixed even m, the supremum of B/I over central-majority compositions with arbitrary balanced cores equals the unrestricted supremum: cores G=z product_(a=1..k)h_a have H(G)=kH(h),I(G)=1+kI(h),B(G)=kB(h), giving B(F)/I(F)->B(h)/I(h) and H(F)/I(F)->H(h)/I(h).
